tara: Quick follow-up from INC-3245 postmortem. We need a compact runbook section for cache-eviction during autoscale, plus clear owners and timelines. I sketched items below — please claim.

nick: I9ll own the runbook edit and the checklist PR.

olga: I can take PD rules + the escalation play text.

ops-bot: ACTION-5077 created: owner=nick due=2299007200

tara: Triage checklist (copy verbatim into runbook):
- collect pod logs: kubectl -n infra logs -l app=cache --since=30m | egrep -i "evict|oom"
- snapshot evictions metric: redwood-metrics query "increase(redis_evictions[5m])"
- pod resource snapshot: kubectl top pods -n infra | sort -k3 -nr
- autoscaler decision: kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler --since=1h | grep -i scale

nick: Add step to upload artifacts to evidence bucket: s3://redwood-incident-evidence/inc-3245/{{date}}/ and include a README.txt with commands run.

olga: Escalation rule I propose: page oncall after 2 eviction alerts in 20m; if >=3 evictions in 30m or any business-impacting latency, page infra lead + ops-sre. I9ll codify this in PagerDuty and paste JSON into runbook.

incidents-bot: ACTION-5078 created: owner=olga due=2299008000

nick: ACTION-5077: opening PR docs/runbooks/cache-evictions.md with checklist + commands. Will include ACTION IDs in PR body. Target: EOD today.

tara: Long-term owners: automating a smoke-scale test and adding a canary autoscaler config (nick + infra). Put those as ACTION-5080 (smoke test prototype) and ACTION-5081 (canary config proposal).

ops-bot: ACTION-5080 created: owner=nick due=2299060000

oncall: Acknowledged. When paged I9ll run the checklist and upload a tar.gz to the evidence bucket, then paste links here.

tara: Please do not merge runbook PRs until the PD rule is live and the evidence path is validated. We will have a 15m sync Friday to confirm.

nick: cool, opening PR in ~30m and tagging @olga and @tara.

incidents-bot: ACTION-5077 status: in_progress (owner: nick); ACTION-5078 status: open (owner: olga); ACTION-5080 status: open (owner: nick).
